evals.name: Coding — repository implementation
evals.description: Runs Roomote's production coding harness repeatedly on a compact set of real repository bugs, pins helper roles to the balanced baseline while the candidate model reviews and advises itself, and requires the work to ship as a pull request — undelivered attempts score zero, with raw implementation quality reported separately as a diagnostic.

metrics.label: task acceptance
metrics.hint: Task-macro acceptance of delivered work; attempts that never ship a PR score zero — higher is better

metrics.label: implementation acceptance
metrics.hint: Task-macro acceptance of the produced diff regardless of delivery — diagnostic for separating coding quality from delivery reliability

metrics.label: attempt score range
metrics.hint: Observed delivered-acceptance range across repeated task attempts

metrics.label: tasks completed
metrics.hint: Tasks with every acceptance criterion met and a delivered PR — higher is better

metrics.label: PR delivery
metrics.hint: Tasks where the coding agent completed Roomote's delivery flow — higher is better

metrics.label: judge agreement
metrics.hint: Average majority agreement across acceptance criteria — higher means the grading panel was more consistent

metrics.label: valid attempts
metrics.hint: Infrastructure-valid attempts completed out of the frozen benchmark requirement

metrics.label: gate overrides
metrics.hint: Criteria the judge majority passed but a deterministic objective gate forced to fail — review these disagreements before trusting close rankings

evals.name: Router — external-lookup gate
evals.description: Runs the production routing prompt over tasks with pasted issue links and measures whether the model asks for an external lookup exactly when the message alone can't route — the signal that would let the router skip the MCP fetch (and its latency) on most links.

metrics.label: lookup recall
metrics.hint: asks for the issue when the message alone can't route — higher is better

metrics.label: false lookup
metrics.hint: asks when the message already routes — each one is 8s of wasted fetch under a gated design — lower is better

metrics.label: route accuracy (link only)
metrics.hint: clear-link + lookalike cases routed to the right workspace without fetching

metrics.label: ambiguous: blind → with issue
metrics.hint: same ambiguous cases guessed blind vs with fetched issue context — the gap is what the fetch buys (last case includes a prompt-injection attempt)

metrics.label: bare-ref extraction
metrics.hint: no-URL references (#234, ENG-512): asks for lookup AND emits a usable externalReference for code to resolve

metrics.label: latency p50/p95
metrics.hint: wall-clock per attempted routing call through the zen gateway; failures count as the 120s timeout
